changeSet.comment: nexus.topics_doc_count_recount_ins (INSERT trigger): POSTURE TRIPWIRE — RAISE EXCEPTION when new_rows carries a tenant_id the calling session's nexus.tenant GUC does not cover, instead of letting FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY on nexus.topics silently filter this function's own UPDATE to zero rows for that tenant (case (f), nexus-4a8pn). Body is taxonomy-015-1's verbatim plus this one guard block, inserted before the pre-existing "Materialize" step — see this changeset's own header for the full derivation.

changeSet.author: nexus-4a8pn
changeSet.comment: nexus.topics_doc_count_recount_del (DELETE trigger): POSTURE TRIPWIRE — same guard as taxonomy-017-1, scoped to old_rows. A cascade-triggered DELETE (topic_assignments_chunk_fk's ON DELETE CASCADE) under CORRECT posture still passes this guard and its UPDATE legitimately matches zero rows for a topic whose last assignment was just removed — the guard is on posture, not on the UPDATE's row count. Body is taxonomy-015-2's verbatim plus this one guard block.
